objective: Locate a publicly obtainable external gastric adenocarcinoma H&E whole-slide cohort with MSI-H/MSS ground truth, to externally re-test within-gastric MSI visibility and colorectal-to-gastric transfer.

queries_executed.filter: files.data_type = 'Slide Image' AND cases.primary_site IN (Stomach, Esophagus, Gastroesophageal junction)
queries_executed.verdict: No non-TCGA gastric slide cohort exists in GDC. TCGA-STAD is the discovery cohort itself.
No additional gastric slide-microscopy collection beyond TCGA-STAD.

candidates_assessed.molecular_data: 165 open cases; 164 methylation, 163 masked somatic mutation, 151 expression
candidates_assessed.verdict: EXCLUDED: rich molecular data but no pathology whole-slide images. MSI labels could be derived, but there are no images to score.

candidates_assessed.msi_label_access: controlled-access dbGaP phs002192 only; not in the open clinical core
candidates_assessed.verdict: EXCLUDED: fails the pre-registered gate by 12.5x on patient count, and MSI labels are not publicly obtainable.
EXCLUDED: 3 MSI-H patients; fails the MSI-H gate by 10x. Also a different lineage (53% squamous), not a gastric replication.
EXCLUDED: cancer-model development resource; too small and unlabelled for MSI evaluation.

candidates_assessed.cohort: Kather et al. 2019 gastric series (KCCH / Kiel)
candidates_assessed.public_status: Not deposited. The associated Zenodo records 10.5281/zenodo.2530835 and 2532612 contain colour-normalised tiles DERIVED FROM TCGA-STAD, i.e. the discovery cohort, not an external one.
candidates_assessed.verdict: EXCLUDED: not external and not obtainable.

candidates_assessed.cohort: Seoul St Mary's Hospital gastric FFPE series; Japanese gastric EBV/MSI series; MSI-SEER validation cohorts
candidates_assessed.public_status: Whole-slide images stated as available from the corresponding authors on reasonable request; no public accession.
candidates_assessed.verdict: EXCLUDED: request-gated, not publicly downloadable within the timeframe of this study.

conclusion: As of the search date no publicly obtainable external gastric cohort meets the pre-registered gate. The negative cross-lineage finding therefore cannot be externally replicated with public data, and internal-external (leave-one-centre-out) cross-validation is reported instead (m4_internal_external_cv_manifest.json).
what_would_resolve_it: A gastric adenocarcinoma cohort of >=200 patients with >=30 MSI-H cases, FFPE diagnostic slides and MMR-IHC or PCR ground truth, from at least one centre outside TCGA. Obtaining one requires a data-sharing agreement or controlled-access application rather than a public download.
